t: Appalachian Arts | Schaefer Center for the Performing Arts | Appalachian State University
s: December 5, 2025 - For over four decades, the Office of Arts Engagement and Cultural Resources at App State has been a driving force behind the High Country’s cultural life. Operating the Schaefer Center for the Performing Arts and Turchin Center for the Visual Arts, the office presents three performing arts series — Appalachian Arts, An Appalachian Summer Festival, and APPlause!
